correctness.rationale: From the actual RESULT.md, with a=n-|S|, b=n-|T| and X=a(n-a)+b(n-b), verified the intrinsic projected normal norm squared X/n and centered facet slack X/2+lambda(1-(a+b)/n). Thus d=sqrt(n)(sqrt(X)/2+lambda(1-k/n)/sqrt(X)). The k<n bounds X>=k(n-k)>=n-1 and k=n bounds X=2ab>=2(n-1) give the two competitor lines. At lambda*=n(n-1)(sqrt(2)-1)/2, separate h=n-k=0,1,>=2 and equality cases; affine interpolation on [0,lambda*] and nonnegative slopes beyond proves every n>=3 real lambda>0, with exactly stated tangent facets. The 2n coordinate contacts make centers unique up to the boundary. Above it, opposite disjoint contacts force x-y=0; minimization of remaining facet restrictions over each union C yields beta_k and a full (n-1)-dim diagonal locus. Independently enumerated 15,162 facet-cardinality comparisons for n=3..23 at six weight regimes; finite comparisons corroborate, not establish universal truth.
